versions.changelog:
lmp-label-generator 1.5.5

- Added a step-by-step section for users on how to configure the cloud preview link (`apiEndpoint`), including rationale, copy-paste example, and privacy explanation.
- Expanded documentation explaining that the online preview API does not upload user identity—only the generated label content is sent to the temporary preview endpoint.
- No functional/logic changes; this update is documentation-focused, making cloud preview configuration easier for all users.

**Security and privacy checks for preview API endpoint added.**

- Now verifies if the configured cloud preview (`apiEndpoint`) is HTTPS and is an allowed/official domain before POST; if not, outputs a clear user warning before sending any data.
- Documentation now states that sample files and all generator outputs must have minimum font sizes set according to updated type rules (≥14pt for standard, ≥12pt for barcode, 10–12pt for nutrition tables).
- Instructions for HTTP request shape when using a configured API endpoint are now more explicit and user-centric.
- Reference examples updated to match the unified font size guidelines.

lmp-label-generator v1.5.3

- New: Filenames are now always sanitized before saving to prevent unsafe paths, disallowing `..`, slashes, control characters, and other risky input. Only safe characters are allowed.
- Clarified: The label is always saved using only sanitized names in the user’s Downloads folder; user input can never alter folder paths or create extra path segments.
- Expanded privacy/security section with warnings: Only proven, trusted HTTPS API endpoints should be used; never store API keys in plain text in config; always use SecretRef or env for secrets.
- No other feature changes; all output and label generation workflows remain as in the previous version.

**Cloud preview is now opt-in for enhanced privacy protection.**

- By default, the skill only saves labels locally; no data is sent externally unless the user explicitly sets `config.apiEndpoint`.
- Added clear privacy instructions: cloud preview (API POST) occurs only if user enables and configures `apiEndpoint` in skill settings.
- Updated config defaults: `apiEndpoint` and `frontendUrl` are now empty by default.
- The description and docs prominently state that no external HTTP requests are made unless configured by the user.
- No changes to output format or LMP generation logic.

- Major update: Enhanced compliance support, improved output, and clarified preview workflow.
- Expanded compliance triggers and logic: Now supports FDA, EU, China GB28050, UK FIC, Supplement Facts, and more; compliance mapping now follows label type table and defined sections in COMPLIANCE.md.
- Output now always includes a local preview link (file://), cloud preview link (if available), official download link, and a concise label summary, with detailed format requirements.
- Updated font/size rules: General minimum font size is 14pt; for compliance/nutrition labels, text and small print may be 10–12pt if needed to avoid truncation.
- Local file path and clickable preview links are now generated using the actual save path (OS-specific).
- Refined label generation logic, compliance explanations, and error handling for both local and cloud preview scenarios.
- LMP JSON output now always includes the required `print` section for better compatibility.

**LMP Label Generator 1.5.0 — Adds direct preview, label compliance support, and font size rules**

- Adds instant preview link: Generates a one-click browser preview link for your label (no API key required) via the /oc/preview API.
- Regulatory support: If you request FDA, EU, or compliant food labels, required elements and format will be checked against new compliance rules (see COMPLIANCE.md). Compliance info is explained in responses.
- All text, barcode digits, and tables now enforce a minimum 14pt font size for legibility.
- Added support for compliance-related triggers (e.g. “FDA label”, “食品标签合规”).
- Updated description and workflow to clarify local file save, preview capabilities, and compliance caveats.
- New COMPLIANCE.md file specifies regulatory layout and element requirements for food labels.
No changes detected in this version.

No file changes detected in this version.

- No changes were made to files in this release.
- Version number was updated only; functionality remains identical.

lmp-label-generator v1.4.5

- Upgraded skill version from 1.4.1 to 1.4.5.
- No changes to triggers, workflow, or configuration documented.
- LMP 标签生成和推送流程保持一致，无新增功能或接口变更。
